name: Amazon Build, Ship, Shape — Alexa+ track
required: Self-hosted MCP server (spec >= 2025-11-25, Streamable HTTP) or a simulated Alexa+ web experience
how_to_enable: Ready. Serve the app and open /alexa. Tools are mounted at /mcp (Streamable HTTP).
summary: A phone-friendly Alexa-style page drives Grasshopper through the official MCP client protocol.

name: Amazon — AWS Builder mini challenge
how_to_enable: Set LLM_STRONG_PROVIDER=bedrock plus AWS_REGION, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and BEDROCK_MODEL_ID.
summary: The strong tier can call Bedrock. Without keys the process logs a warning and stays on the mock model.

name: Amazon — Open Source mini challenge
required: Public repo with an OSI license
how_to_enable: Ready. LICENSE is MIT.
summary: Grasshopper is MIT licensed and structured so a reviewer can run make test with no keys.

name: Nebius x NVIDIA Global AI
prize: Nebius Token Factory + NVIDIA open model
required: Nebius Token Factory and at least one NVIDIA open model, public repo, open license, video <= 3 min
how_to_enable: Set LLM_FAST_PROVIDER=nebius, NEBIUS_API_KEY, NEBIUS_BASE_URL, and NEBIUS_FAST_MODEL.
summary: The fast tier is the Nebius slot. Router logs show how often cheap calls replace the strong model.

name: Nebius — Tavily bonus
how_to_enable: Set SEARCH_PROVIDER=tavily and TAVILY_API_KEY.
summary: SearchProvider has a Tavily implementation. Missing key falls back to the offline index.

name: Open Agent Hackathon 2026
required: An agent that does real work and can explain why
how_to_enable: Ready. Every step writes runs/<id>/explain.jsonl and the run page renders it.
summary: The explainer records the reason, the alternatives, the evidence screenshot, and the verifier result.

name: OpenCV AI Competition
how_to_enable: Ready. requirements.txt pins opencv-python-headless 5. vision.py scores page change and numbers click targets.
summary: Screenshots are diffed with absdiff and annotated with numbered contours before a vision model would see them.

name: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair
required: Blockchain integration plus a pitch video
how_to_enable: Set WALLET_PROVIDER=solana_devnet, a devnet SOLANA_RPC_URL, and WALLET_KEYPAIR_PATH. Mainnet URLs refuse to start.
summary: Payments hit a daily limit, a per-transaction limit, and a human approval before the ledger moves.

name: Build With AI: Basics
how_to_enable: Ready. make test runs the sandbox scenarios with no API keys.
summary: The sandbox plus the dashboard is the prototype reviewers can click through.

name: AI GENESIS (lablab)
how_to_enable: Ready.
summary: Natural language in, verified browser steps out, with a memory of what worked.

name: Rise of AI Agents (lablab)
how_to_enable: Ready. Confirm the deadline on the event page before submitting.
summary: The queue, scheduler, and approval gate let the agent run unattended until a risky step.

name: Kaggle Gemma 4 — Paper Track
required: Gemma used in an agent workflow
how_to_enable: Set LLM_REPAIR_PROVIDER=ollama and GEMMA_MODEL. self_repair.py is the call site.
summary: When a step throws, the repair tier (Gemma via Ollama) is asked for a unified diff that is not auto-applied.

name: HETIC AI Agents for Founders
how_to_enable: Ready. Shop listings, subscriptions, and competition research are the founder flows.
summary: The shop and competition playbooks are the founder demos.

name: Arbiter Hacks V1
how_to_enable: Ready if the organizers open applications to independent teams.
summary: Marked ineligible for the demo profile until the organizer confirms independent teams can enter.

name: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2027
required: At least two Microsoft AI services (Azure OpenAI + Azure Speech)
how_to_enable: Set LLM_STRONG_PROVIDER=azure, AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY, AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT, STT_PROVIDER=azure, AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION.
summary: Azure OpenAI is the strong tier and Azure Speech is the STT tier. Both fall back to mock without keys.

name: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon
how_to_enable: Set LLM_STRONG_PROVIDER=meta, META_API_KEY, META_BASE_URL, META_MODEL, and the WHATSAPP_* variables.
summary: Meta's OpenAI-compatible endpoint and the WhatsApp webhook are both behind env flags.

name: Vultr Agent Rush
how_to_enable: Default runner is local. Docker is optional. VULTR_API_KEY creates a short-lived instance.
summary: Each run writes blast_radius.json with files, domains, duration, and cost.

name: IEEE ClimateChain
how_to_enable: Mock wallet records a sentence only when the page contains it.
summary: A small climate-claim check. It does not make this repo a climate product.

name: YTU x Meta Student Hackathon
how_to_enable: META_API_KEY, META_BASE_URL, META_MODEL, and WHATSAPP_* .
summary: Clients exist. The December event is in person.

name: ING Hubs Agentic AI Hackathon
required: Team of two; topics on 9 October
how_to_enable: Open /bank on the sandbox. No extra key.
summary: Approval, limit, and an audit trail. Adapt after the topics arrive.

name: Kestra Hacktober
required: Your own merged Kestra contributions, outside this repo
how_to_enable: Not this repository.
summary: No Kestra pull request lives here.

name: ASUS UGen AI League
required: 20 page deck and a short video
how_to_enable: Read submissions/asus/PRESENTATION.md. No device key.
summary: Stage I deck. UGen300 is not attached.

name: Hackster Nordic
how_to_enable: No flag to turn on.
summary: Rules were not found. Prize was not invented.

name: AssemblyAI Voice Agent
how_to_enable: STT_PROVIDER=assemblyai and ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY.
summary: The STT client is tested against a fake server. This demo is not a voice agent.
